    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.not_ftm_both {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] {x y₀ y₁ X Y : P} {σ : x ⟶ y₀} {ρ : x ⟶ y₁} (hσ : IsLong σ) (hρ : IsLong ρ) (hv2 : ¬∃ (c : y₁ ⟶ y₀), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ρ c = σ) {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ≠ 0) (h1 : FactorsThroughMorphism σ f) (h2 : FactorsThroughMorphism ρ f) :
